comment: The acceptance matrix for judge-base and the white-box template. Every row is a failure mode the judge
must report distinguishably, because the platform only sees an exit code and an event stream.
exit codes: 0 ok, 2 misconfigured image, 3 swap folder missing, 4 offline restore refused,
5 wall clock exceeded, 6 does not compile.

personas.name: red
personas.comment: Compiles, two aspects wrong. Red tests are a result, not a failed run - this is what makes partial credit possible.

personas.name: broken-code
personas.comment: Does not compile. Must be Failed with a diagnostic, never Completed-with-no-results.

personas.name: missing-folder
personas.comment: No JudgeFixture.Services folder. Reported without having deleted the placeholder first.

personas.name: adds-package
personas.comment: Adds a package reference absent from the baked feed. The offline restore must refuse it.

personas.name: slow
personas.comment: Endless loop. The image's own wall clock must cut it off; the platform has none, and its worker is serial.
